figurative_meaning_en: An extraordinarily beautiful woman or a renowned beauty
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে ডাকের সুন্দরীর মতো দেখতে সুন্দর।
গ্রামের সেই মেয়েটি ডাকের সুন্দরী হয়ে উঠেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: She looks as beautiful as a postcard beauty.
That village girl has become a renowned beauty.
note: Refers to idealized beauty often depicted on old postcards or stamps, evoking nostalgia in Bengali culture.
